path: PI/PI/10 加拿大 James 活跃 Xtransfer 轻度绑定/JCSL-Custom power pcb.docx
name: JCSL-Custom power pcb.docx
method: python-docx(段落+表格+文本框+页眉页脚)
text:
Goal of project
Request 1
– Modify the Power PSU circuit board to have power and alarm contacts exit the BACK of the module.
Board can be extend past the holes by up to 1” more if needed. PCB Mounting Holes to remain where they are
Keep connector profile facing into the middle of the board as it currently is.  Could be changed to Molex MiniFit-JR style for  power, and JST or similar for alarm contacts.
Request 2:
Add thermal sensor to Power board to monitor heat dissipation to chassis
Adding and programming an i2c or i3c temperature sensor to monitor the heat from the power board to the chassis  - if and only if facilities exist in the marvell software to monitor it.
Request 3:
Add 2 pcs of fan headers for 3 or 4 pin fan and controls to run a 40mm PC fan using PWM and TAC support in OS
(use Noctua 4 pin PWM 5v fan specifications: https://noctua.at/pub/media/wysiwyg/Noctua_PWM_specifications_white_paper.pdf)
Headers to be placed on back of board facing away from port edge for easy connection and disconnection
Request 4:
Provide additional power DC-DC buck convertor to provide 75w of 12v DC to a connector on the back of the board.
We are currently adding an additional power buck converter to power the PC.  It would be great to have one less component to power from the external power supply.
Header using Molex - Mini Fit JR type connector, 2x2 pin out.
Requirements
Total height not to exceed existing size between boards.
All tall components to be placed facing towards network board
Final system must continue to meet or be better than the requirements FCC and noise emission regulations required
Must meet FCC Part 15 Class B, CE, RoHS
[文本框]
Rotate power block  and circuitry 90 degrees
Add Alarm IN contact     to match Alarm out
Minifit JR  out
DC DC 12v DC buck circuit
